lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to use the timer and counters to limit time, increase difficulty as the game goes on, and end the game cleanly.
A countdown variable starts at a number and goes down by 1 every second.
When it reaches 0, the game ends.
Store the speed in a variable and increase it over time.
Use the variable in the movement block so everything speeds up.
When lives reach 0 or time runs out: show the final score and stop all.
A clear ending makes a game feel finished.
Players should feel “I almost made it — one more go!”
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
